## Summary
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noUselessDateGetTime`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has an [**unsafe**](/linter/#unsafe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`unicorn/consistent-date-clone`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn/blob/main/docs/rules/consistent-date-clone.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noUselessDateGetTime": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow calling `.getTime()` on a date before passing it to the `Date` constructor.

Passing a `Date` object to `new Date()` creates a copy of it.
Calling `.getTime()` on the date first does the same thing with extra code.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
const copy = new Date(date.getTime());
```

### Valid

```js
const copy = new Date(date);
const timestamp = date.getTime();
```
